name: An invitation to dine with Colonel Fanshawe
note: EXTRACTED from docs/23-inventory-act1.md (Act II items) by tools/extract-content.mjs. Do not edit: change doc 23 and re-run. Handed over by Sump at the end of A9. Kept. Errata 66 ruling A: shown to the character at C5 and kept; never consumed.

LOOK_AT.say: 'Colonel A. Fanshawe requests the pleasure of Mr. Grubb at dinner, this evening.' Engraved. The evening was printed before I was.
repeat: My name has been written in by hand, in a space left for whichever name it turned out to be.
It was waiting at the Registrar's before I had finished registering. I am trying to take that as a compliment.

LISTEN_TO.say: Heavy card. It does not rustle. It announces.
repeat: Nothing. It has said 'this evening', and that was all it needed to say.
